title: LIT on Topstep Combine 50K (eval + funded)
question: Which accounts should run LIT next to the MFFU Builder 50K, and what do they pay a month net of fees?
verdict: Topstep Combine 50K: eval p10/f10 H1 9.4/0.0 H2 6.4/0.0, eventual pass 66.4 / 79.5%, pass_med 22.0 / 26.5; funded MC 6 months $1854 / $1676 a month, lost 3.5 / 7.1%; 6 months from purchase net of fees $1180 / $984 a month (H1 / H2). notes: tools/lit_funded_firms.py; stored trades = back-to-back real history (eval sized by the plan's eval sizing is not stored; only the funded trades). The run library's eval columns are not this plan's numbers: those are in the verdict and research/lit/funded_firms.json.
